messages:
sara: Customer ACME reporting ~200ms extra tail latency, app appears to hit eu edge instead of APAC for some users. They say they set region header in their SDK.
jun: any request IDs or example headers? can we get a curl that reproduces it? :mag:
sara: pasted the snippet the customer gave:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx' \\
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\
  -H 'X-Client-Region: *' \\
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4o-mini","input":"hi"}'
```
jun: aha — they sent X-Client-Region: "*" (literal wildcard). router code expects a specific region token, but we may be treating unknown tokens as "no preference" which triggers fallback routing to first available region (eu-west for this account).
router-bot: [alert] Incoming header value '*' not in allowlist -> mapped to default_region (eu-west)
tim: that's bad. We should either reject unsupported values with 4xx or map to nearest region based on geoip when feasible. Current behavior is dangerous because of surprise cross-region traffic.
sara: customer says their SDK docs said passing '*' should mean "auto" (pick closest). However our SDKs historically used empty/absent header to mean auto. mismatch between doc and implementation.
jun: can we confirm whether older SDK versions set header to '*'? maybe a bad client lib. check logs for incoming raw header values for that org.
router-bot: query: last 24h for org:acme corp, header X-Client-Region="*" -> 1,958 hits, peak at 2419800900
sara: customer is on an embedded SDK fork — they probably added '*' as convenience. They're unhappy about cross-region egress billing and latency hits.
jun: short repro locally, confirmed: when X-Client-Region header equals '*' router falls through to default_region. curl above routes to eu-west and latency matches their report.
tim: mitigation plan:
- patch router to reject wildcard tokens with 400 + clear error message (internal ticket #INF-4921)
- add telemetry alert when unsupported region tokens > 1% of traffic
- add quickfix to edge: treat '*' as geoip-based auto for accounts with geoip setting enabled (safer fallback)
jun: filing PR to change behavior in router: will make unknown header values return HTTP 400 with body: "invalid region header; use one of: west, eu, ap-southeast, or omit header for auto". also add link to SDK guidance.
sara: logged case with customer, gave workaround: remove X-Client-Region header or set to explicit "ap-southeast". asked for permission to apply temporary edge rule to rewrite '*'->'' for their org to unblock.
tim: ok to add org-scoped rewrite as temporary bandaid for acme. add expiry 72h and notify legal/billing.
jun: PR created: https://git.redwood/infer/router/pulls/1127 - includes tests for '*' and other sentinel values. will roll canary in few hours.
sara: customer confirmed they'll remove '*' from their fork for now. leaving thread open until router patch deploys. :thumbsup:
